ui_bugs.issue: 'Care-Plan Changes' truncates to 'Care-Plan Ch...' at 390px viewport (client width 196px, scroll width 231px). Title is ellipsised because AppHeader title uses numberOfLines=1. Reference: /app/mobile/app/amendments.tsx:90 (title prop) + AppHeader component.
'AT & HM Projects' truncates to 'AT & HM Proj...' at 390px viewport (client width 196px, scroll width 216px). Same numberOfLines=1 issue as amendments. Reference: /app/mobile/app/athm.tsx:79.

integration_issues.issue: Letters mailbox loaded 6 correspondence entries but returned 0 overdue and 0 upcoming follow-ups for cathy@example.com's active participant, contrary to review-request note that the seeded participant has follow-ups. May be participant_id filtering mismatch OR the seeded follow-ups don't have due_at values in this env. Verify /lf1/follow-ups?participant_id=<active> returns items via curl to confirm whether this is a data issue or a client-side filter.

issues: Any screen with a title longer than ~15 chars ellipsises. Consider allowing title to wrap to 2 lines (numberOfLines=2) OR shortening titles ('Care-Plan Changes' -> 'Plan Changes', 'AT & HM Projects' -> 'AT & HM'). This is a generic AppHeader constraint that affects multiple new screens.

action_items: Fix AppHeader title truncation on /amendments ('Care-Plan Changes') and /athm ('AT & HM Projects'): allow title to wrap (numberOfLines=2) or shorten titles. Occurs on 390px viewport.

Verify /lf1/follow-ups returns overdue/upcoming items for cathy@example.com's active participant. If seeded, the mobile client should render them under 'letters-overdue'/'letters-upcoming' cards; if not seeded, treat as data-fixture gap.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/mobile/app/amendments.tsx save() correctly sends sender_name from useAuth() user.name with 'Primary caregiver' fallback, and generated_letter output is wrapped in sanitizeAI() at line 156 to strip dashes for the preview.

/app/mobile/app/scenarios.tsx save() posts event_type + effective_date, source is omitted (matches curl contract). apply_transitions=true is passed. Groups fetched via useEffect (not participant-dependent).
/app/mobile/app/athm.tsx advance() uses optimistic UI (setItems then PUT); if the PUT fails it calls load() which will revert — good pattern.
/app/mobile/app/letters.tsx uses Promise.all with .catch fallbacks to prevent one failing endpoint from blocking the other — resilient.

AppHeader title is being ellipsised (numberOfLines=1 on the title Text). For new screens with longer titles, this cuts UX quality. Consider a global fix in AppHeader (numberOfLines=2 with tight lineHeight).

rca of the issue: Title truncation RCA: AppHeader Text component uses numberOfLines={1} (default single-line behavior for React Native title Text). At 390px viewport minus icons/right-button, the available title width is ~196px; strings like 'Care-Plan Changes' (231px) and 'AT & HM Projects' (216px) exceed that. Fix options: (a) numberOfLines={2} on title with a tighter lineHeight, (b) shorten titles, (c) render right-button below title on narrow viewports.
